title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Tamamo Cross has yet to overcome her fear of running in packs, she decides to race in the Japanese Derby, all bandaged and bruised.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Proud to have earned a place among the top eighteen racers of her generation and determined to stay strong for her family, she readies herself for the race.
